Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
RUN VARIABILITY (observed): room contents and layouts vary between runs—e.g. extra rock enclosures/rock corridors around the hub's left door, new enemies spawning mid-visit. Don't assume a fixed layout; treat prior room maps as approximate and re-verify.

CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrows fire/set facing; key+arrow combo strafe-fires in independent directions (confirmed). E places bombs (left-click doesn't). Space uses active item (no visible effect with Match Stick or Tech X). Q card use/drop unconfirmed. Movement approx: 0.1s≈40px, 0.2s≈80px, 0.3s≈120px, 0.4s≈160px, 0.5s≈200px. Inputs occasionally drop—retry or test single axes before assuming a wall. Door/hatch/trapdoor transitions need centered overlap (both x and y matter) PLUS 2–3 repeated presses; sometimes step out and re-enter. HYPOTHESIS (uncertain): exits may stay locked while enemies are alive—hatch that failed repeatedly opened after the room was cleared, and the boss-room trapdoor never opened with fats alive; but alignment also confounded this.

PLAYER: sprite renders inconsistently (white/pink blob, TV-head, skull, yellow, cream, pale damage-blink, gray-faced) and can resemble enemies—confirm identity by moving/firing and watching which sprite responds.

HUD/PICKUPS (observed): hearts hollow after damage; blue/soul hearts from blue pill; counters for coins/keys/bombs; two item/card slots; top-right icon stack. All-hollow hearts observed repeatedly: game stays interactive/controllable for many turns (movement and firing still work) though death typically follows—keep acting until a result screen. Pickups on touch; coins/small items need exact overlap and may register a step late. Silent inert floor objects are scenery. Poop sometimes hides items. Some crates damage on contact. A pedestal can re-grant TECH X. Gold-framed keyhole left door in the brown hub: one run it was walked through with 1 key held without consuming the key; in a later run it failed every aligned press (rock corridor flanked it)—possibly locked/one-way some runs; unresolved.

TECH X (observed): radial ring tear with red X impact, radius ~140–150px; blocks own line of fire; point-blank unsafe. Damages fatties, gray faces, shelled enemies, flies, spider clusters. Does NOT crack rock rings, TNT barrels, gray crates, rock clusters; embedded eye-faces survive (likely invulnerable). y-offset >~70px misses. Item banners (TECH X; MATCH STICK 'Tastes like burning'; 2 OF SPADES 'Item multiplier') can replace the active item; after Match Stick ring bursts stopped visibly (unconfirmed); Space with Match Stick no effect. In the final run only plain straight tears were used—current loadout unknown.

TEARS (observed): travel straight, blue splash on impact; must match target's x or y—misalignment by ~100px+ misses. Plain tears fired repeatedly killed gray-faces, white-faced shelled enemies, and chipped fatties slowly.

ENEMIES (observed): winged flies tanky, chase/fire tears downward. Fats (pink/white/gray-faced) extremely tanky, enrage with red aura/red cheeks/open black mouth, chase relentlessly; contact drains hearts fast—lost 2 hearts in seconds; die in red splatter. Shelled white-faced enemies emerge from spiky rock piles, fire blue/green orbs, retreat into shell (immune), leave persistent damaging green spiky clouds—never linger; new ones can appear later in the same room. White round creatures burst with a splash and spawn flies/other enemies. Gray-faced enemies slow until enraged (open black mouth) then charge. Black spiders cluster, deadly close. Hazards: green clouds, poison puddles, brazier flames, loose orbs, falling sack tears. Gilded sack with fly fires teardrops.

NAVIGATION (observed, per-run approximate): Tutorial room ('BASEMENT I', MOVE/ATTACK/BOMB/ITEM paintings): top hatch ↔ brown rock hub; bottom trapdoor ↔ brazier room; right dark riveted door ↔ dark stone room. Brown rock hub: top hatch ↔ TNT room; bottom trapdoor ↔ tutorial; left gold keyhole door ↔ shop (shop keeper at top-center with a gray pot beside it—shooting near the keeper angered it, stop firing; bomb 5¢, 2 OF SPADES card 15¢; right gold-handled door back to hub). TNT room: two isolated barrels mid-room flank a safe central gap (~x≈680–700); left-wall TNT cluster, gray crates (inert), reddish barrel; bomb-bug idles left; top hatch ↔ boss room; bottom trapdoor ↔ hub. Boss room: central rock pile blocks fire lanes; left dark statue with red glow (invulnerable); embedded eye-faces in right rock wall (invulnerable); gilded sack with fly at right firing teardrops; card on floor bottom-right (~790,395); two fatties roam; bottom trapdoor ↔ TNT room; no other exit; very punishing.
